I built a custom 3-tier brick grill right in my yard to prepare an incredible outdoor feast! 🔥🐙 From tender boiled and char-grilled octopus to juicy marinated beef steaks, tiger prawn skewers, and fresh mussels simmered in a rich tomato sauce, this village meal has it all.

To complete the feast, I roasted fresh garden vegetables over glowing coals to chop up a vibrant homemade salsa, brewed traditional coffee in hot salt, and wrapped everything into massive, mouthwatering village tacos for the local kids. True outdoor cooking and village hospitality at its finest!

🔔 Make sure that you have the bell turned on, so you will definitely not miss any of our videos!
